decisions.reason: SOL keeps the meaning and smooths the past-perfect narration.

SOL keeps the swelling energy and mingling lights in natural English.

SOL retains the request to remain in Murim unchanged as he has until now.

SOL preserves the contrast that some did not change.

SOL carries the loss of focus into the following sentence.

SOL preserves his reaching toward the light beyond the darkness.

SOL preserves saving the words “younger brother” for their reunion.
